name: select-trainer
description: Guides users through configuring the PINA Trainer for solver training, including batching strategy, data splitting, and Lightning options. Use when the user asks "how do I train", "how to train", "set up training", "trainer", "Trainer", "train my model", "fit", "training loop", or similar. Also triggers when the user mentions batching, training configuration, train/val/test split, or is confused about how to start training.
